deficiencies.description: The rewrite states that the cervix is seen 'alongside' the endocervical canal, converting the lecturer's deictic pointing words into a specific spatial description that is not stated in the text.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: Histologically, this is the endocervical canal here, and so you're looking at the cervix here.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: and the cervix is seen alongside it
deficiencies.caseForForbidden: The rewrite turns the lecturer's pointing words ('here... here') into a spatial relationship ('seen alongside it') that the lecturer did not give and that the text does not substantiate.
deficiencies.caseForAllowed: The phrase is merely an attempt to smoothly describe the elements being pointed out on the histological slide.

considerations.sourcePassage: here is the endocervical canal that it goes between the neck of the womb
considerations.reason: Rendering 'goes between the neck of the womb' as 'runs through the neck of the womb' is an acceptable clarification of spoken phrasing expressing the passage of the canal through cervical tissue.

considerations.sourcePassage: You can see maybe with sharp eyes, you'll see that there's a mitotic cell here and there's one here
considerations.reason: This is a direct remark guiding the audience's eyes to specific examples in an image; the essential subject-matter fact that mitotic cells occur at the basement layer is preserved in the rewrite.

considerations.sourcePassage: The uterus is here in this diagram, and as you know, it hangs down into the vaginal canal.
considerations.reason: Changing 'The uterus is here in this diagram' to 'The uterus hangs down into the vaginal canal, as shown in the diagram. [FIGURE]' is an allowed handling of figure references and style.
